Module com.example.miniproyecto3
Package com.example.miniproyecto3.util

Class AnimationUtil

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3.util.AnimationUtil
public class AnimationUtil extends Object
Collection of static helper methods that apply JavaFX animations (and, in a few cases, paired sound effects) to UI nodes: card transitions, button hover/press feedback, turn highlighting, and elimination/error feedback. This class cannot be instantiated; all functionality is exposed through static methods.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Maria Alejandra Pizarro Sarria, Alejandro Valencia Sandoval

    • sendCardsToDeck

      public static void sendCardsToDeck(List<javafx.scene.image.ImageView> cards, javafx.scene.image.ImageView deck, Runnable onFinish)
      Animates a group of card views moving toward a target deck view (translating and fading out simultaneously), compensating for any rotation applied to each card's parent container, then hides them and resets their transform/opacity once the animation finishes. Used both when a card is played (moving toward the discard pile) and when a player is eliminated (their hand moving back into the draw deck).
      Parameters:
      cards - the card views to animate; invisible cards are skipped.
      deck - the target deck/pile view to animate the cards toward.
      onFinish - callback invoked once every card has finished animating (may be null).
